notes: Requirements vary by applicant and source: the asking page requires German B2 for the whole seven-semester programme ('German language skills at B2 level are only required if the entire seven-semester degree programme is completed in Albstadt'), whereas the university application FAQ asks for a B1 German certificate for the application. Programme duration is given as seven semesters (3.5 years) on the German page, but the partner-university sections (https://www.hs-albsig-international.de//field-of-studies/industrial-engineering) label 'Duration Semester 5-7 with partner university / 1.5 years', which is only part of the programme. Tuition: 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU students, plus a semester contribution (183.70 EUR per the university page; the DAAD page says approx. 180 EUR for 2026). Deadlines given as recurring, no year stated on any page for this programme. Application channel: the pages state online registration in the university's own portal; no uni-assist (VPD) step is mentioned for this programme, so the codes de-uni-assist/de-uni-assist-vpd were not used.
